title: 7S.3/S3.7 shared-surface parameter memoization
scope: Memoize the immutable scalar parameter projection of shared ACIS surface nodes within one wireframe extraction
Preserve ordered per-face projections and the existing surface parser's partial/default behavior
Add generated shared-surface work and exact/one-under budget controls to the existing test owner

behavior.cacheKey: source surface node index within one extractAcisWireframeImpl invocation
behavior.cachedData: surfaceType, hasSurface, p0/p1/p2, hasUDir, ratio, sineAngle, cosineAngle, majorRadius, minorRadius from the existing surfaceParams routine
behavior.budgeting: one maxOutputItems unit per distinct referenced surface cache entry, charged before parsing and insertion; this bounds cache entry count, not allocator bytes or RSS

generatedControls.input: In-memory ACIS 21800 SAB with one shared plane-surface and one or eight face records referencing it
assertions: Each output face remains present in source order
Each face retains plane type, hasSurface, origin (1,2,3), normal (0,0,1), U direction (1,0,0), and hasUDir
Eight-face extraction work exceeds the one-face case but remains below eight times the one-face baseline
Exact extraction-work and output-item limits admit the projection
One-under extraction-work limit refuses and clears caller-visible output
generatedControls.measurementLimit: Deterministic extraction-work counter only; no wall-clock benchmark

nextLocalAction: Extend the existing per-loop projection cache to retain a loop's resolved next-loop index as well as its coedge-ring count; preserve per-face loop rows and cycle guards, and validate with the existing generated shared 4x4 loop graph.

workingTree.reasonUncommitted: The shared worktree contains broad overlapping user changes; no isolated commit could be made safely.
